'''2024 North American Continental Championship''' was the Players Committee North American Continental Championship at the Heldrich Hotel in New Brunswick, New Jersey, 9–11 August 2024. [[Brian Fred]] finished 1st in the Day 2 Top 8 cut.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-08-north-american-continental-championship-new-brunswick-new-jersey-august-9-112024/ 2024-08 North American Continental Championship – New Brunswick, New Jersey (August 9-11, 2024)], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org (12 August 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014140710/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-08-north-american-continental-championship-new-brunswick-new-jersey-august-9-112024.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Day 1 ==

The Day 1 column gives each player's place in the Day 1 standings as numbered on the Players Committee results page, which also gives the Top 8 cut order.<ref name="pc" /> The Top 8 came from Day 1: Brian Fred, Chris Gogolen, Bill Kafer, Joe Olson, Sam Tashima, Phil Aasen, Matt Sokol and Greg Shaw.<ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/nac-2024-wrap-up-brian-fred-is-victorious/ NAC 2024 Wrap-Up – Brian Fred is Victorious], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org (15 August 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016175713/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/nac-2024-wrap-up-brian-fred-is-victorious.html Internet Archive]</ref>
